_comment: The one closing block for every free resource page. Change the words here, then run: node scripts/apply-closing.mjs (the older pages in public/ carry a written copy; the build fails if it drifts). No date is ever written here: the date line comes from workshop.config.json through /workshop-next.json.
heading: Ready to fix the next thing?
line: Once a month I run a free one-hour workshop for women running established service businesses. We take one process that depends on you and build a better way of doing it, live.
